description:
## Goal
Retain the exact reads of a failed compiler derivation in the existing scheduler dependency owner, so unchanged input does not retry failed compiler work and relevant dependency movement reawakens the producer exactly once. This is a prerequisite of removing standing-wait scans in fz-kdt.46.

## Evidence
On fz-tfn/long-lived-recalculator, base ad0ac47d3, the parked .46 scope-aware frontier candidate exposes failed_macro_product_remains_demanded_after_retirement_and_source_repair. The first macro lowering reports lower/unbound for Missing.value/0. After retiring its retained product session and replacing the macro source with quote 40 + 2, the request must return 42 and recreate RootBackendProduct generation1. Instead it stalls on Settled(RootEntry(root3)); exact standing prerequisites include Current(LoweredBody(Function31)), StaticCallees, InputDemand and Recursive. Logs: /tmp/fz-kdt46-macro-diagnostic.log, /tmp/fz-kdt46-macro-waits.log, /tmp/fz-kdt46-macro-ground-oracle.log. A temporary test-only comparison against the former upstream support predicate matched throughout; it was removed. This is not an established external-witness mismatch.

jobs/body.rs::lower_function records FunctionDefined(function) and other reads locally, then collect_local_*? and lowerer.lower()? can return FatalError before JobEffects carries those reads into Scheduler. Drive error paths exit without completion/subscription. The initial failed producer therefore has no precise read edge to wake on source repair. The old unresolved inventory scan masked this by redemanding the missing producer. Direct existing-API RED on the blocker base independently proves this attribution: /tmp/fz-tfn46-failed-reads-red.log fails because the actual failed LowerFunction retains no FunctionDefined read.

## Strategy
Follow .agent/strategies/output-contract-loop.md. Establish failure as a typed outcome at the existing job/derivation ownership boundary. Preserve attempted exact reads and valid prior claim/finality semantics when evaluation fails; retain diagnostics with correct source provenance. No parallel failed-job registry, replay queue, per-request rescanner, unconditional retry, invented empty-read conclusion, or job-to-job enqueue authority. Trace all normal/product/nested drive paths and existing error contracts before choosing the minimal coherent model. Audit other fatal job paths for the same loss; do not patch only LowerFunction while leaving the shared contract contradictory.

## TDD and acceptance
- An initially failing producer retains exactly the reads actually observed before failure; no fabricated downstream reads or output claims.
- Repeating an unchanged failed request does no producer evaluation; an unrelated edit does not retry it. Relevant read movement wakes it once, repair succeeds, and another unchanged request reuses the result.
- Pin the real failed macro retirement/source-repair scenario, diagnostics and generation1 restoration. Narrow the existing Capture event borrow around inspection so it cannot hide retry diagnostics.
- Preserve failed native/backend product retry, nested active roots, reconciliation-only demand scope, ordinary blocked/concluding derivations, retraction and ground-shift finality. Explicitly define what happens to previous successful claims after a failed re-evaluation and prove consumers cannot observe stale success.
- One World fact authority and one ProductMemo artifact authority; failure dependency state lives at the existing dependency owner. No display strings or incidental ordering as semantic authority.
- Deterministic causal work counts and same-version artifacts. Target fixtures through interp/run/build, full library, serial matrix, CLI/cross-process checks, docs and strict clippy/fmt; fresh ticket-scoped cold review before one commit/close.
- Remove all temporary probes, A/B/oracle paths and scaffolding. Update fact-engine/pipeline/error-contract documentation from final code.

## Execution boundary
Dependency order is fz-tfn.48 -> fz-tfn.46 -> fz-kdt.46. Each parked candidate is restored only after its prerequisite lands and is revalidated independently. Do not edit historical worktrees or blindly apply prior experiments. Root owns staging/commit/close/push; implementation agent owns Cargo until explicitly released. Push only after the preceding exact pushed head CI succeeds. No deferral of this failure-ownership contract is authorized.


## Recoverable branch boundary
Root selectively stashed exactly the kdt.46-owned 18 tracked and 2 untracked files in commit69e41a8d2cf2681ca65b3b76c0fc29bbe6a666d1 (message: fz-kdt.46 scope-aware edge candidate parked for fz-tfn.46 failure ownership). All unrelated untracked measurements remain in place; at parking, source returned to ad0ac47d3. Do not drop this stash. Restore by explicit immutable stash commit only after separately reviewed fz-tfn.46 lands, resolve overlaps with its final owner model, and revalidate all kdt.46 gates. The former implementation owner is released; implement_tfn46_reconcile now owns selective source restoration and the blocker source/build workflow. Root owns index/commits/push.

## Current implementation model
A compiler attempt returns exclusive Result<JobEffects,FatalError>. FatalError transiently carries actual fact/product reads and an immutable shared FailureDiagnostic. Completion transfers reads into the existing DependencyIndex job record's ordinary subscriptions, retains only its diagnostic payload, and withdraws all old claims/contributions. Failed analysis clears return, analysis, and callsite payloads only where its last actual claim disappeared; surviving copublishers keep their values. Native contextual fallback fills only silent errors and preserves specific diagnostics plus attempted reads.

Diagnostics are constructed without emitting. The normal pending agenda continues after a failed completion; exact definition/body/contract movement may replace a provisional failed outcome before terminal reporting. Bare drive uses the guarded terminal failure inventory. Queued reconciliation keeps only transient attempted-failed job IDs and selects a still-failed owning record in semantic order. Product requests follow exact blocking dependencies, including finality-only unquiet Current-product support, through existing World/Scheduler/ProductSessions ownership. String/user boundaries report original payloads once; compiler FatalError hooks forward them purely. No retry queue, priority ordering, blanket settled-read gate, global normal failure scan, or duplicate retained read/diagnostic registry exists.

All scoped-module errors retain observed ModuleIndexed. Struct-obligation collection borrows the owning actual-read accumulator across successful earlier field consultations and later failures, including separate type declarations; fieldless references do not fabricate schema reads. Semantic contract-declaration consultation consumes the exact FunctionContractKind projection of the existing defined surface. The original own-definition availability guard remains; removing it was an obsolete intermediate approach superseded by terminal publication.

- Repeated original lower/unbound source diagnostics, unchanged/unrelated no LowerFunction retry, healthy retained root7, exact repaired42: /tmp/fz-tfn46-replay.log.
- Exclusive activation contribution withdrawal RED caught preserve-frontier misuse; exact conclude_exact(empty) fixes real World join while sibling contribution survives.
- Cold review ModuleIndexed RED→GREEN /tmp/fz-tfn46-module-red.log and module-green.log.
- Cold review accumulated schema reads RED→GREEN /tmp/fz-tfn46-struct-red.log and struct-green.log; spec and separate type declarations preserve A+B, exclude fieldless Unused.
- Return-store RED /tmp/fz-tfn46-return-owner-red.log exposed stale Some(old) after claim withdrawal. Exclusive/shared semantic payload controls GREEN3 /tmp/fz-tfn46-payload-green.log.
- Fully captured recursive failure/repair RED /tmp/fz-tfn46-recursive-captured-red.log established stale provisional spec diagnostics. Terminal publication GREEN /tmp/fz-tfn46-terminal-recursive.log; own-contract failure/repair also passes in broad library.
- Pure FatalError reporting-boundary controls GREEN5 /tmp/fz-tfn46-pure-fatal.log. Native original-specific versus silent-context fallback terminal reporting GREEN /tmp/fz-tfn46-native-diagnostic.log; additional exact-read/shared-payload fallback test added.
- Finality-only attribution RED→GREEN uses a real retained product generation with unquiet validation; Current(parent) remains available, Settled(parent) finds original failure, diagnostic traversal schedules no work.

## Exact contract-declaration projection (approved strategy)
Goal: retain the metadata actually consulted by failed semantic calls without making every caller depend on a callee's whole body or increasing healthy work. Signal: body-only edits keep declaration revision stable and do not wake metadata consumers; Undeclared/Declared/Extern transitions move exactly once, absent projection means pending rather than undeclared; initial exact work pins and recursive/own-contract repairs remain green.

DefineFunction and the existing generated-lambda LowerFunction publication each co-own their FunctionContractKind projection derived directly from its existing FunctionState surface, with no new producer job or parallel value store. The three variants encode declared contract and extern enforcement policy. Semantic consumers subscribe to that fact; actual own source spans still subscribe to FunctionDefined. The former boolean query is removed: the kind is derived from the existing surface, and the public accessor is gated by the owned fact. Interface-only providers bypass ordinary kind readiness explicitly through observed module/interface authority; absence does not mean Undeclared for ordinary functions. TDD covers body-only stability, all declaration/policy transitions, pending metadata wait, healthy work counts and failure repair. The coarse callee FunctionDefined read is replaced by the actual projection. Metadata readiness RED /tmp/fz-tfn46-kind-red.log is GREEN; transition checks prove body/spec type changes leave kind revision stable, policy changes move it and failed definition withdrawal hides retained raw metadata. Deferred struct registration RED /tmp/fz-tfn46-deferred-schema-red.log is GREEN: note_struct_field_expectation returns a successful actual validation read, or None for a deferred obligation; later schema publication validates deferred fields, including the invalid-field control. No generic self-read filtering or absent-read omission is used.

## Generated ownership and valid rooted refresh demand (approved strategy)
Goal: generated definitions and kind metadata retain their real lowering-parent owner through failure and repair, without demanding invented source jobs or obsolete retired children. Signal: exact owner-level failed attribution, no DefineFunction(generated) attempts, source success41→success42 and success41→failure→repair42, unchanged no work, shared/cyclic membership preserved.

FunctionMap's existing per-ID identity now carries typed generated origin; the single producer map routes both Defined and Kind to LowerFunction(parent). Corrected existing-API mapping RED /tmp/fz-tfn46-generated-owner-mapping-red.log reports None instead of failed LowerFunction(0); typed routing GREEN /tmp/fz-tfn46-generated-owner-green.log. Earlier /tmp/fz-tfn46-generated-owner-red.log failed fixture syntax before reaching ownership and is NOT target RED evidence.

Exact routing exposes retained rooted membership demanding old generated31 before pending parent main refresh can remove it. Both success→success and failure→repair stall with typed routing; old-map A/B /tmp/fz-tfn46-generated-old-routing.log returns42 only by attempting forbidden DefineFunction(old generated), so this regression cannot be deferred. Same-position source labels separately hit existing fz-tfn.45; these controls vary offsets to isolate ownership and do not claim that identity-label defect solved.

Integration after48: the parked rooted-refresh projection is superseded by48, not a second implementation to restore. Read-only comparison of immutable stash288b1531c515bf02f4ac9375ae422e8eb3c1ad58 with the active48 cutover identifies the following seams; final code and gates must be rechecked after48 lands.

- pull/rooted.rs: do not restore RootedRefresh, RootedProducts::refresh, ProductMemo::rooted_refresh, their ancestor map/frontier sorting, or the parked read_rooted_products adapter. Preserve48 DirtyWitness, the actual RootedRead position/delivery controls and transactionally retained contribution changes.
- pull.rs and drive.rs: port the immutable failure payload, but adapt ProductSessions::dependency_uses to the current PendingProduct and ordered observations. Its parked implementation flattens pending/produced dependencies into a Vec of settled product facts; World::failed_fact_dependency sorts that set. Do not assume this diagnostic traversal is a valid authority for an obsolete suffix: prove attribution follows currently justified observations, including prefix invalidation and rooted reads. This is an integration risk, not a claim that a reproduced failure-attribution regression has already been observed.
- product_drive.rs: retain48 request-stamped frame ownership, cancellation, reconciliation and teardown. Merge46 failed-job completion followed by normal pumping into that loop. Reconcile cancellation before attributing a terminal failed prerequisite; an obsolete failed producer must be ignored just as48 ignores an obsolete missing producer, while a still-required failure retains its original diagnostic.
- failure.rs, deps.rs, scheduler.rs, world.rs: retain46 actual failed reads on existing dependency owners, immutable diagnostics, exact claim withdrawal, exclusive payload cleanup and surviving co-publisher ownership.
- identity.rs, drive.rs::fact_producers and source/body producers: preserve exact generated origin, LowerFunction(parent) routing and FunctionContractKind projection. Product cancellation alone does not eliminate the forbidden obsolete semantic job.

Restore selectively from the explicit immutable snapshot after the reviewed48 commit, preserving current48 paths; do not apply the parked adapter wholesale. Required integration controls include both real generated-owner success41→success42 and success41→failure→repair42 with no obsolete generated product or semantic job; exact failed-read repair and unchanged/unrelated no retry; prior-success withdrawal and co-publisher preservation; terminal_settled_fact_follows_unquiet_current_product_ground_to_its_original_failure ported to current request IDs; obsolete failed-prerequisite cancellation plus still-required original failure; and48 prefix/nested-frame/recursive ownership/work controls. Re-measure against committed48 without erasing the original healthy-work budgets. The parked247vs246 body-walk and2441vs2440 non-RuntimeDemand differences remain unresolved, not new expected values.

## Current status: reconciling onto committed fz-tfn.48
Prerequisite fz-tfn.48 is reviewed, committed as e616d82d13cc4e916bfae8e5a48e5219ac680d8a, closed and pushed. Its CI34019976927 is running; work may proceed, but the next push requires that exact head to pass. Agent implement_tfn46_reconcile now owns selective source restoration, implementation and Cargo. Root owns index/commit/close/push/PR/CI. The following parking details are historical recovery evidence, not current acceptance. The source/index returned clean to ad0ac47d3; all unrelated untracked measurements remain untouched. Restore by explicit commit only, not mutable stash index, after48 lands. Do not resume or apply this candidate until48 has a reviewed commit. No final source freeze or current full-gate pass is claimed.

The generated-origin routing correction exposed an existing dependency-bag defect: main ABI first asks Materialized(main) and Effects(main), but retained Effects(main) validation follows obsolete Effects(old31) before consulting the current producer's first Materialized(main) read. This separates48 product-demand correctness from this ticket's exact semantic/generated-definition ownership requirement; it does not waive the no-old-job assertion.48 retains a permanent source-level no-obsolete-product-request control. On restoration, keep and pass this ticket's stronger no-DefineFunction(generated) success/failure/repair controls, with the superseded rooted adapter removed, before claiming combined source repair.
